teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! My name is Tim and I have a TEFL certification. My lessons will be created to help you with your needs as a learner, and will be a mixture of engaging activities and games aimed at getting you to practice different aspect of the language. I will first assess your current level of English, and try to understand from you what your needs are as an English learner. From there on, I will develop lesson plans that will focus on aspects of the language that you could improve on. I am a language learner myself, currently I am learning how to speak Spanish. My experiences as a language learner have given me insights into what activities and exercises are most useful when trying to learn a language. For several years, I lived with some people that were learning English as a second language. I would help them with their language learning almost every day, so this gave me further insights into what it takes to effectively teach a language. I have a bachelors degree in Anthropology, and through my studies I was introduced to many different cultures and ways of interacting. While working on my degree, I would write papers (essays) regularly for class. This has given me good training in how to properly write a paper, which I can help you with as well if that is something you want to work on.
